name: Derives
description: The target is derived from the source (e.g. a system requirement from a user requirement).

name: Satisfies
description: The source satisfies the target (e.g. a software requirement satisfies a system requirement).

name: Verifies
description: The source (a test case) verifies the target (a requirement).

name: Refers
description: Informative reference between any two objects; not counted in coverage.
